test_is_torch_available: test whether the torch package is installed and available in the current environment
test_is_flash_attn_available: test whether the flash_attn package is installed and available in the current environment
test_is_torch_version: test whether the installed torch version satisfies a given version constraint like '>=' '2.0.0'
test_compare_versions: compare a library version against a requirement using an operator like '>=' or '<' to validate version compatibility
test_is_xformers_version: test whether the installed xformers version satisfies a given version constraint like '>=' '0.0.25'
